body:
an Array of ideas with @dailyobjects_official ˚✩☁︎︎⋆｡

Since the time I was in high school, I used to be the type of kid who went all out in doing up her study desk. From posters, to organizers to boxes of stationery… you name it, I had it all 🧑🏼‍🩰Even throughout by bachelor days and at my Master’s dorm, my work desk was where the real magic happened, and I made sure I kept it equipped and decorated in the way that best fit my style, and my work-ways ⋰˚☆

The Array from @dailyobjects_official has been my latest addition to my desk, and it holds all my most reached-out-to everyday tools — my pens, drawing pencils, washi tapes, and has storage to segregate them according to your use case!
Also, this may be very specific to me, but I am super particular about how my desk organizers look; and it’s really tough to find a nice, functional, spacious one in the colour of your choice! The Array in ‘Sand’ couldn’t have been a better choice for me <3

Super blessed to be able to create (and get this organiser haha) with the folks at DO again 🫶🏽

#dailyobjects #deskorganization #ad
